native.build: Same native GCC13 SPDK RelWithDebInfo LTO build cache; build both pinned commits, freeze production binaries with tests/fault injection OFF, retain separate drivers.
native.tests: Grouped metadata/hash units; complete ordered E2E suite; three separate repetitions per version of Stream large-RDB roundtrip and ListIndirect full-disk RESTORE/expiration recovery. Existing timeouts unchanged. Failures stop the chain and are retained.
native.tmp: Private mount namespace binding task scratch on /mnt/dev over /tmp; host /tmp unchanged.

performance.seeding: For each read pair, fresh parent-seeded population, each version restarted on the same unchanged data. Writes freshly seed each version separately. Validate every key, source/binary identity, errors and clean exits.
performance.storage: Six authorized scratch NVMe only, SPDK. Existing host restoration and global lock required.
performance.host_serialization: Do not acquire/build/test until complete Hash/Set clean+perf chain reports success. All local native builds/tests and clean performance measurements run serially.
performance.ci: Remote CI is recorded separately; performance measurement does not by itself establish correctness.

fixture_repair: Two Python mock compatibility fixes only; production unchanged versus rebased eccea5c7
